page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Optimized3.Flex.8-32 is a compute-oriented virtual machine configuration powered by the x86_64 architecture. It provides 8 physical cores and 16 virtual CPUs operating at a base clock frequency of 3.0 GHz, backed by an Intel Xeon 6354 processor. The instance features dedicated CPU resource allocation with two hardware threads per physical core, ensuring consistent computational performance without multi-tenant vCPU contention.

The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per virtual core. It does not include hardware GPU acceleration or integrated local NVMe storage, meaning persistent disk requirements must be provisioned via attached network block volumes. Network connectivity includes one complimentary public IPv4 address for remote ingress and egress management.

Because of its dedicated core allocation and compact memory profile, VM.Optimized3.Flex.8-32 is architected for CPU-bound applications that do not demand extensive RAM capacities. It is well matched for tasks such as continuous integration and automated build pipelines, batch computation, web serving clusters, and CPU-driven mathematical modeling where steady single-thread and parallel throughput are required.
